# PixieLib (temporary copy)

A copy of `dotnet/PixieLib` and `dotnet/PixieLib.Generators` from
[Sakamoto0110/PixieLib](https://github.com/Sakamoto0110/PixieLib), commit `7e0ec32`, unchanged.

It stands in for a proper way of shipping PixieLib (a package, or the submodule this replaced) until
one is decided. Don't edit these files here: change PixieLib in its own repository and copy the two
folders again, updating the commit above.

Only `InteractiveEditor/InteractiveEditor.csproj` references `PixieLib/PixieLib.csproj`; the
adapters get PixieLib through the core.
